relations.label: The opening agitation returns
relations.basis: In Rimsky-Korsakov’s concert version, opening fast material returns after contrasting episodes; these excerpts link the opening with the renewed-pressure section marked near 365 s. CENS diagonal mean 0.924, sustained 15.5 s, fixed pitch-class shift 0 semitones and time offset 343.5 s (cache/form/mussorgsky-night-bald-mountain.txt, candidate 3; 0.5 s grid). These are matched excerpts, not complete section boundaries; timing has not been checked by ear.

candidatesRejected: The 24 s and 14.5 s matches after the bell lie over the quiet D-centred foundation and are not identified as large formal repetitions. Early transposed figures and a shifted dance match are left as local motivic candidates rather than assigned to unverified programme events. This relation applies to Rimsky-Korsakov’s version, not Mussorgsky’s 1867 score.
